text:
ellie: quick heads-up — onboarding hf://some-org/new-chat-model produced a bunch of failed tool-call tests in the rw conversion pipeline this morning. failing assert is JSON parse error from tool output.
cheng: ugh, do we have an example of the raw generation? is it the model emitting literal tool tags or raw JSON?
ellie: raw snippet from logs:
```
assistant: {"tool":"get_user","args": {"id": 42}}
```
but tokenizer split the beginning of the JSON across tokens and we got: `{"tool":"get_` + `user","args":{...}}` so our post-processing can't detect the tool tag boundary.
mike: that smells like missing special tokens. on HF the model was trained with explicit sentinel tokens `<|json_mode|>` and `<|tool_call|>`. if the tokenizer on conversion doesn't add them as single tokens they get split.
ram: also saw this when we applied 4-bit quant to the model for benchmark runs — not that quant changes tokenization, but small probability shifts made the model choose outputs without the explicit sentinels. we should handle both tokenizer gaps and generation fallbacks.
ellie: what did the hf tokenizer config.json have? any `additional_special_tokens` there?
cheng: config.json snippet from the repo:
```
{"bos_token": "<s>", "eos_token": "</s>", "additional_special_tokens": ["<|tool_call|>", "<|json_mode|>", "<|role_assistant|>"]}
```
but our rw conversion script was not calling `tokenizer.add_special_tokens(...)` before saving the tokenizer to the runtime bucket.
mike: quick fix: in the hf->rw conversion step do `tok.add_special_tokens({"additional_special_tokens": specials})` and then `tok.save_pretrained(...)` so Redwood's tokenizer files include those as single tokens.
ram: alternative/safer: canonicalize tool call detection in the conversion layer — prefer regex that tolerates splits, e.g. allow `\{\s*"tool"\s*:` across token boundaries, then rejoin tokens before json.loads. but that's brittle.
ellie: agreed — do both: add tokens and make postproc tolerant. also add a unit test that loads the saved tokenizer and asserts `"<|json_mode|>" in tokenizer.get_vocab()`.
cheng: small gotcha: some HF models use the fast tokenizer (tokenizers lib) which sometimes normalizes the sentinel into subword pieces unless `use_fast=False` or you rebuild the tokenizer with the special tokens at training-time. for converted ones, re-saving with `add_special_tokens` on the fast tokenizer usually works though.
mike: sample patch I think will work — drop into converters/hf_to_rw.py:
```
# ensure special tokens are preserved as single tokens
specials = ["<|tool_call|>", "<|json_mode|>", "<|role_user|>", "<|role_assistant|>"]
tok.add_special_tokens({"additional_special_tokens": specials})
model.config.pad_token_id = tok.pad_token_id
tok.save_pretrained(target_dir)
```
ram: also update chat template mapping. hf chat format uses role strings; our runtime expects explicit role tags in the serialized prompt. conversion should map roles to our markers so downstream parsers don't rely on whitespace boundaries. example mapping:
```
role_map = {"system": "<|role_system|>", "user": "<|role_user|>", "assistant": "<|role_assistant|>"}
```
ellie: after that we still saw a couple regressions in the regression suite when we quantized to 4-bit -- the model sometimes omits the `<|tool_call|>` marker entirely and emits inline JSON with no sentinel.
mike: for quantization runs we should run an eval set that checks: (1) sentinel present, (2) JSON parseable, (3) tool name in allowlist. if sentinel missing, fallback to reranking: ask model to emit only JSON after a short prompt "You MUST respond with JSON_MODE_START ... JSON_MODE_END".
cheng: adding tests: create `tests/onboarding/test_toolcall_tokenization.py` with a test that loads the converted tokenizer and runs tokenization on a set of sentinel examples and asserts no splits. also add an integration acceptance test that runs the conversion + lightweight gen on CPU with `--sample-seed=42` and checks deterministic tool boundaries.
ellie: can someone take the conversion patch + test? i'll own the acceptance test harness and perf runs.
ram: i'll open a PR for the converter patch, add a commit that logs the tokenizer vocab head after save so we can quickly debug missing special tokens in the future.
ci-bot: build started for PR #4823 (hf->rw tokenizer special tokens) — running unit tests.
mike: after PR we should also add a backward compatibility shim: if older models lack sentinels, try to detect canonical JSON payload via content heuristics and convert to tool-call envelope during ingress.
ellie: ok thanks — priority: get tokenizers saved with special tokens + add unit test. follow-up: bench the 4-bit quant variants and add regression alerts if tool-call success rate drops >1%.
cheng: noted — i'll add the unit test and the small regex-rescuer in postproc. will ping when PR is ready.
ellie: thanks all :thumbsup:
